::: {.teach-intro}
This lecture collection covers classical and intelligent approaches to system identification, from mathematical modeling and nonparametric estimation to neural networks, fuzzy inference systems, and ANFIS. The materials combine theoretical foundations, worked numerical examples, MATLAB and Python implementations, and engineering applications involving fluid systems, power-system dynamics, and drone control. Each lecture has its own page with the slides embedded, a structured outline, and a link to the original presentation.
:::
